records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ines,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 0 (2026-08-14) but nothing since; no invites, no tickets, and no reply to either outreach (email:baab24c1, email:7ff191ee) across 6 days. Silent, single-user accounts with 8 days left rarely self-activate, though Pro plan and an existing project leave some chance.

draft.subject: Next step in Wrenfield for Pioneer Labs
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

You've got a first project up in Wrenfield, which is the main organizing unit, with tasks living inside it. The next step that usually makes it click is getting someone else in alongside you: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I can walk through how you're organizing projects and tasks and what to put in front of your team first.

Best,
Priya
